She also worked as a Lamaze childbirth educator and perinatal grief counselor. Linda’s professional interests encompass wellness before, during and after pregnancy, as well as prior to and after menopause. Working at CWH, she is privileged to provide care for women of varied ethnic, cultural and social backgrounds. Linda’s personal interests include her husband, sons, dog, traveling, reading, and card making.
